CustomObject.label: Sanctions Screening
CustomObject.description: Immutable record of a single OFAC / sanctions screening event against a party on a loan. Append-only -- never updated, never deleted (ADR-24, DESIGN-kyc-ofac.md). Parents on Loan__c (deleteConstraint=Restrict). A changed result is a NEW record, never an edit; the newest Screened_At__c for a Loan__c is the current disposition, the chain is the audit trail. APPEND-ONLY.
